correctness.rationale: For p,q>=3 and nonempty nonfull deleted matching, all same-side pairs have two-edge geodesics with opposite-part common neighbors missing at most two matched vertices. These conditions are necessary and sufficient, including for all missing-edge endpoint pairs of distance three via explicit internal vertices. This establishes exact independent partwise admissibility. Binomial disallowed omissions give the full polynomial; minimal allowable omitted sets are one unmatched singleton or three matched vertices, giving the complete maximal polynomial. The packaged standalone BFS verifier independently tests all graph shortest paths, all 2^(p+q) subsets, exact bivariate coefficients, and maximality on 41 small parameter instances; finite checks corroborate rather than prove the all-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: The natural one-parameter family interpolates from a complete biclique toward a crown under disjoint edge deletions. Its complete bivariate polynomial counts every total-visible placement, and its maximal polynomial reveals a genuine threshold at the third deleted edge: three distinct maximal-cardinality layers and a sharp lower-vs-upper gap of four, although the upper number stays fixed. The counted maximality spectrum is not determined by previously known scalar parameters; both structural classification and exact census are reusable finite and infinite-family data.
